meta.title: Compression tiers & workbench
meta.description: Five-tier context compression plus a workbench: the vial above the composer shows live usage and the system / tools / messages split, the appearance page offers two palettes (deep obsidian and daylight crystal, each with its own light and dark values, so a palette follows DSH's theme instead of overriding it) and three motion tiers, and a palette repaints the whole DSH app through the host theme service. A reasoning slider under the official model menu's reasoning-level row changes the session's reasoning effort in place. Tiers switch from the Compression tiers panel in the sidebar and apply to every preset engine at once, no restart, with automatic pressure compaction kept on each tier; the five pages of that panel also edit the global AGENTS.md and the supplement block at the top of each registered workspace's AGENTS.md, detect or download four managed components (GitHub CLI, git, ffmpeg/ffprobe, Python — resumable, rollback on failure, managed copy first on PATH), download a local model (FLUX.2 [klein] 4B, 4-step distilled, kept in its own models folder below the download root), and show GitHub token scopes and the network check; the repository pill above the input decides where github_push publishes. Tools: compression_tiers, compression_context, compression_compact, github_push. It downloads components from GitHub releases, gyan.dev and python-build-standalone and the model from Hugging Face; with the plugin off, tiers stop syncing, managed directories leave PATH, and the tools and panel disappear. Limits: tiers assume 256k-token windows or more and only preset-isolated engines are updated; the vial reads official context projections and shows a dash when they are missing.
